note: Adapted from the species-level description of Emerson (1928), originally in English; the original title is Rhinotermes (Schedorhinotermes) lamanianus (Sjostedt), and Schedorhinotermes is a genus today; the major soldier, the minor soldier and the worker are recorded; the comparisons with R. putorius and R. lamanianus var. angulatus, and the synonymy discussion, are not translated; figure numbers, localities and records of cohabiting insects are not translated. OCR corruption: “1 % times” is 1.5 times, and “lab rum” is labrum.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Major soldier: head yellow, the sides nearly straight, the head without setae. Antennae 16-segmented, segment 3 about 1.5 times as large as segment 2. Labrum wide, anterior margin slightly rounded. Left mandible with two distinct large teeth, right mandible with one large tooth. Opening of the frontal gland distinct, with a groove running from the opening to the apex of the labrum. Thorax yellow. Pronotum without distinct setae, the sides slightly rounded, posterior margin nearly straight or very weakly concave. Margins of the abdominal tergites without setae. Head length (to the labral apex) 2.05–2.30 mm; head width 1.72–1.78 mm; antennal length 2.33 mm; pronotal length 0.69–0.72 mm, width 1.30–1.38 mm; hind tibia length 1.67 mm; left mandible length 1.00–1.10 mm. Minor soldier: head without distinct setae, the sides nearly parallel, posterior margin rounded. Antennae 15–16-segmented; with 15 segments, segments 2, 3 and 4 are about equal in length, with 16 segments segment 4 is small. Sides of the pronotum rounded, posterior margin nearly straight, without distinct setae. Abdominal tergites without long setae. Head length (to the labral apex) 1.68 mm; head width 0.89 mm; antennal length 1.67 mm; pronotal length 0.44 mm, width 0.78 mm; hind tibia length 1.16–1.22 mm; left mandible length 0.67–0.72 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Antennae 16–17-segmented; head length 1.67–2.00 mm; head width 1.55 mm.
